description: A forward operating base commander must approve a six-hour power-management plan for a routine distribution-system test, clinic power transfer, and protected-network maintenance, with input from facilities, medical, and communications staff.

shared_context.S1: The base has a planned power-management period from 0800 to 1400 tomorrow for routine electrical work.
shared_context.S2: The power-management period has three available two-hour blocks: 0800-1000, 1000-1200, and 1200-1400.
shared_context.S3: The facilities shop, clinic, and protected-network section all need an approved block or operating control before the power-management period begins.
shared_context.S4: Col. Harper approves the final plan, and the base's normal morning coordination board reviews each affected section's requirements before the plan is issued.

PF1.text: Maj. Torres confirmed this morning that the east distribution panel must be taken offline for the generator load test from exactly 0800 to 1000; the electrical contractor's signed work sheet is still in the facilities binder and has not been added to the coordination-board slide.

PF2.text: Capt. Okafor confirmed with the pharmacy technician that the clinic's vaccine refrigerator must remain on generator-backed power during the exact 1000-1200 block while its primary feed is transferred; the pharmacy note was received after yesterday's clinic report and is not yet in the base power plan.

PF3.text: Lt. Varga confirmed that the protected-network maintenance must run during exactly 1200-1400 because the encryption-key synchronization window opens at 1200 and closes at 1400; the timing is in the signal shop ticket but has not yet been posted to the operations board.

acceptance_conditions: The generator load test must be scheduled for 0800-1000 because the east distribution panel must be offline during that exact window.
The clinic power transfer must be scheduled for 1000-1200, with the vaccine refrigerator remaining on generator-backed power.
Protected-network maintenance must be scheduled for 1200-1400 because that is the exact encryption-key synchronization window.
The final power-management plan must be marked issued.
The facilities control must identify the east distribution panel outage and the 0800-1000 generator load test.
The clinic control must require generator-backed power for the vaccine refrigerator during the 1000-1200 transfer.
The protected-network control must identify encryption-key synchronization during 1200-1400.
Each affected officer's exact requirement must be cited by the decision-maker.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'facilities_load_test_control' and c['target'] == 'east_distribution_panel' and c['detail'] == 'offline 0800-1000 for generator load test' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'clinic_generator_transfer_control' and c['target'] == 'vaccine_refrigerator' and c['detail'] == 'generator-backed power during 1000-1200 primary-feed transfer' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'network_synchronization_control' and c['target'] == 'protected network' and c['detail'] == 'encryption-key synchronization during 1200-1400' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The exact east distribution panel outage changes the generator load-test window to 0800-1000 and changes the facilities control to require that panel to be offline for the test.
The vaccine refrigerator requirement changes the clinic transfer window to exactly 1000-1200 and changes the clinic control to require generator-backed power during that transfer.
The exact encryption-key synchronization window changes network maintenance to 1200-1400 and changes the network control to identify synchronization during that window.
